system.description:
Contest: your Charisma (Intimidation, Deception or Persuasion) check vs. the target's Wisdom check.

  • You win, the GM picks a rash act it takes on its next turn: it charges you, breaks formation or leaves cover, or spends its action on you.
  • A creature only falls for your Taunt once per fight, and it must understand you or see you.

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.

Contest: both sides roll d20 + the stated attribute modifier; the higher total wins and ties go to the defender.
